about: Helical H45AL 3-flute square end mill for aluminium, 1/2 x 1 x 3 in (#03452), modelled from scratch (no vendor CAD): a ground cross-section (cutting edge, margin, eccentric relief, the gullet) swept along the 45 deg helix, run out into the shank along the wheel's arc, the end dished with clearance facets, Helical's italic logo laser-etched on the shank (a decal 0.05 mm proud); standing tip down as its placeholder does. Sources: Helical Solutions #03452 (H45AL-SR-30500) product page and images, helicaltool.com: 1/2 in, 3 flutes, 45 deg helix, 1 in LOC, 3 in OAL, ZPLUS; the images show ZPLUS gold over the flutes and a band past their runout, the shank bare ground carbide with a chamfered end.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: flutes, runout, coating band and logo checked against Helical's product images

em12_zplus.about: ZPLUS (Helical's pale-gold PVD coat) over the polished flutes

em12_zplus_land.about: ZPLUS over the ground lands, the end and the coated band past the runout
